Moms, honest question: what's the dinner you make when you're completely out of energy?

How I hit ~120g protein without a single shake:

Breakfast: 3 eggs + Greek yogurt → ~35g
Lunch: chicken wrap → ~36g
Snack: cottage cheese → ~24g
Dinner: salmon or turkey → ~35g

That's it. Real food, 4 meals.

For years I ate badly and felt bad all the time.

My weight kept swinging. Too much, then too little, then too much again.

What fixed it wasn't a diet. It was a simple plan: real food, protein in every meal.

Anyone else been on that rollercoaster?

• Tuna on 2 rice cakes ≈ 22g
